records.process_summary: Satisfactory Academic Progress appeal: MTSU Financial Aid SAP Appeal Form, a personal statement on the extenuating circumstances for each semester, and documentation, emailed to One Stop (no in-person appeals). A denied appeal with merit but insufficient documentation may go to the Re-Appeals Committee. Approval places the student on an academic plan.
records.deadline_text: No fixed deadline; late submission may not be reviewed before fees are due.

records.process_summary: Institutional Scholarship Appeal to regain eligibility lost through unmet GPA or enrollment requirements (serious illness, financial hardship, CPoS/major course limits, other difficulties). Incoming freshmen or transfers who missed a scholarship deadline because of a serious extenuating circumstance may also appeal. Tennessee Lottery Scholarship enrollment appeals go to the monthly Institutional Review Panel.
records.notes: Retention and missed-deadline appeals, not reconsideration of award amounts; does not qualify the paid add-on.
